title: Window Cleaning Job Work Order Form
subtitle: Control access setup, exclusion, glass cleaning, equipment control, inspection, and release through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete window cleaning job work order for windows, frames, anchors, ladders, lifts, ropes, tools, and exclusion zones. It connects work plan, access method, anchors, products, and site approval to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a trained window-cleaning technician must control authorized window cleaning work from arrival and baseline findings through change approval, service evidence, testing, and handoff.

sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This window cleaning job work order is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when anchorage, access equipment, fall protection, rescue, weather, electrical, public exclusion, facade, glass, or drop-zone condition is uncertain. A access and fall-protection supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
